sm.$description: Blur radius for subtly elevated surfaces (2px). Apply on elements with minimal visual lift, like inline cards or hover overlays. Part of elevation tier 1 — pair with effects/offset/1 and effects/spread/negative/1.

md.$description: Blur radius for elevated surfaces (8px). Apply on elements with clear visual lift, like dropdowns or floating panels. Part of elevation tier 2 — pair with effects/offset/2 and effects/spread/negative/2.

lg.$description: Blur radius for highly elevated surfaces (16px). Apply on elements that float above most content, like modals or drawers. Part of elevation tier 3 — pair with effects/offset/3 and effects/spread/negative/3.
